title: Cardinality of permutations of a finite set
statement: Let $E$ be a finite set of cardinality $k$. Write $\operatorname{Perm}(E)$ for the set of bijections $E\to E$. Then $|\operatorname{Perm}(E)|=k!$, where $k!=\prod_{j=1}^{k}j$ and the empty product is $1$. Finite sets use [def-sfb-finite-infinite-set].
